pos: Use case: logo-brand. Deliver ONE finished premium Windows 11 / Android app icon for JAMANVAAR POS, a heritage Indian restaurant SaaS. Square canvas, 1024x1024 PNG. A full-size rounded-square Fluent squircle tile filled with exact deep emerald #0E4D3C; genuinely transparent outside its four rounded corners. Centered hospitality symbol entirely inside the inner 66% of the canvas: an elegant stylized open hand extending from a dark navy #0B253A sleeve, presenting a simple golden amber serving tray and cloche dome, with three broad, short soft curling steam wisps rising above it. Steam is dark navy with a slim warm gold edge for contrast on emerald. Gold dome subtle saffron-to-gold gradient (#F27E2B, #FDE047), strong broad shapes, minimal confident geometric vector-like silhouette, tasteful polished craftsmanship. Hand may use warm pale gold to read against navy sleeve; sleeve has a single gold cuff. Modern compact composition, recognizable at 16px, spacious 17% safe-zone padding, balanced visual weight. NO text, letters, wordmarks, food photo, watermarks, extra circular border, fine filigree, drop shadows, cast shadows, 3D scene, bevels, glow, or outlines around whole tile. Artwork only, flat front-on icon, no mockup or presentation board. The squircle should extend to the canvas edges, transparent corners only.
